mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notes (action_plan_id, type, title, body, mastery, progress, category_id, github_path, commit_sha, repo_name, created_at, user_id) VALUES (#{action_plan_id}, #{type}, #{title}, #{body}, #{mastery}, #{progress}, #{category_id}, #{github_path}, #{commit_sha}, #{repo_name}, #{created_at}, #{user_id});
mapper.update: UPDATE notes SET action_plan_id = #{action_plan_id}, type = #{type}, title = #{title}, body = #{body}, mastery = #{mastery}, progress = #{progress}, category_id = #{category_id}, github_path = #{github_path}, commit_sha = #{commit_sha}, repo_name = #{repo_name} WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{user_id};
